angle: A in chapters: Intro (the problem, on camera) → 01 Capture → 02 Bind → 03 Recall (incl. when it stops) → Mikael on how it decides → tally → lockup. Erkki's fix is the carrier throughout.

feature.name: The context layer
feature.shipped: A layer that captures an expert's fix from normal chat and email, binds it to the network graph and recalls it for the next engineer
feature.one_thing: The expert's fix reaches the next engineer — sourced, scoped, and with no forms
feature.viewer: Elisa's network operations and AI leads, and hackathon voters
feature.task: Erkki's fix for TRN-042 travels to TRN-087 and TRN-105
feature.before: the fix lives in one expert's head; when he's away the team starts from zero
feature.after: the fix reaches the next engineer, sourced and scoped, with no forms

voice: narrated by Abhishek and Mikael in their own voices (recordings to come)

beats.vo: Mikael (voice): It also knows when to stop. A 2023 unit is beyond anything Erkki has seen, so it declines and asks where the edge is. A road closure expires on the date the engineer gave. And when Erkki takes a tip back, it goes under review, not deleted.

beats.vo: Abhishek: In the demo we read fourteen conversations, stored four tips from six sources, ran eleven incidents, and passed seventeen test scenarios and forty-nine break tests. And the engineers filled in zero forms.

shots.motion: Numbers count up one value per frame (M936 stepText), staggered 0.25 s left to right, row by row; captions fade in 0.2 s behind each number; 17 and 49 land last in green on the beat

shots.motion: Every number flies to the centre and shrinks into the 0 (0.6 s, power3.in), the 0 punches in at 1.15 and settles to 1 (back.out); 'forms' slides in from the right; the pink underline draws left to right in 0.5 s; the line above fades in last. Then it holds dead still
shots.screen: 'All of it, in the demo, needed' above a huge '0 forms' (470 px), pink underline, 'for the engineers to fill in'

beats.subject: the demo's real tally line, not M936's '6 weeks'

Then the turn: every number flies into the centre and shrinks into the '0' (0.6 s, power3.in), the '0' punches in at 1.15 and settles (back.out) with a one-frame pink flash, 'forms' slides in from the right, the pink underline draws left to right (500 ms), and 'All of it, in the demo, needed' fades in above. It holds dead still about 2.5 s, the longest hold in the film. OUT: the underline shrinks into the lockup's pink full stops.
